cards.title: Match content format to query intent
cards.claim: The passage categorizes search queries as informational, navigational, and transactional, with different suggested focus areas.
cards.action: For informational queries, use blogs, guides, or snippets; for navigational queries, focus on branded SEO and site links; for transactional queries, use product pages, schemas, and CTAs.
applies_when: The query is primarily seeking knowledge or definitions.
The query includes a known brand or website name.
The query indicates purchase, download, signup, or subscription intent.
do_not_use_when: Query intent is unclear or combines multiple intents.
unknowns: No evidence is provided that these formats improve rankings or conversions.
The examples and recommendations appear to be instructional summaries, not documented test results.

"information query is basically to understand to look to look for some knowledge point of view like what is SEO? It can be your blogs, guides or snippets."
"navigational queries means it is already a well-known website, a brand name."
"focus area will be your branded SEO and site links."
"Transactional means purchasing point of view. Downloading anything, subscription, uh subscribing anything"
"where you can create in terms of products, pages, schemas and CTS."

cards.title: Use transactional terms and markup for commercial-intent queries
cards.claim: The passage identifies purchase, subscription, booking, and price-related terms as transactional and recommends using product reviews, offers, and structured data with transactional queries.
cards.action: Use product reviews and offers with transactional queries, and use structured data to appear in rich results.
applies_when: Users show commercial intent, such as buying, subscribing, booking, downloading, or seeking a price.
Queries include examples such as "buy iPhone 15 online," "SEO courses subscription," "book hotel in Goa," or "best price for posting plan."
do_not_use_when: The query is informational or navigational rather than commercial.
unknowns: No specific schema types or implementation details are provided.
The passage does not provide measured ROI, CTR, or rich-result outcomes.
evidence_quotes: "some someone who is going to purchase anything or you can say download anything or going for a sign up right so it comes under your transactional query"
"So product review and offer you can utilize with the transactional queries. You can use a structured data to appear in the rich result"

Managing branded SEO or reputation management.
